name: Object storage (S3-compatible)
description: Adds presigned upload/download against an S3-compatible bucket, without routing file bytes through the app server.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: S3-compatible provider the presigned-URL client targets.

inputs.name: maxUploadBytes
inputs.description: Largest object size a presigned upload URL will accept (default 10 MiB).

generatedArtifacts.description: Presigned upload/download URL helpers; the app server never buffers file bytes.
Issues a short-lived, size-bounded presigned upload URL to an authenticated caller.

verification.description: Requests a presigned URL, uploads a test object through it, and reads it back.

operationalEvidence.evidence: Bucket name, region and credentials are all environment variables documented in .env.example — never hardcoded or committed.
Presigned URLs are short-lived, scoped to one object key, and size-bounded by maxUploadBytes — the bucket itself is never made public.
